sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
Substrate Bank is the largest independent material library of substrates for digital printing, connecting buyers, specifiers, and print professionals with material manufacturers.

Industry: Digital Printing Materials · Size: not published · Products: Digital print substrates, Wallcovering, Film, Vinyl, Textile, Paper

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: Substrate Bank scores 14 of 100 (tier disqualified) at 85% confidence. The score is carried by pain-point alignment (10/15). Nothing was found for application fit, company size and event engagement, so those score zero rather than being estimated.

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: They already market on weatherability, lifespan, which means the durability conversation is a product discussion rather than an education. Relevant Tedlar positioning: Tedlar's proven outdoor weatherability extends graphic life in harsh climates. Tedlar overlaminates let printers underwrite longer graphic warranties.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: Closest known-good accounts: Mactac (29% similar on vinyl, film, printing, digital); Drytac (19% similar on print, film, vinyl, display); Avery Dennison Graphics Solutions (13% similar on vinyl, window, digital, film). Reference the comparable account by name on the call — a converter is far more persuaded by what a peer does than by a spec sheet.

sections.heading: Who to talk to
sections.body: No decision-maker resolved from public sources. Target titles for this ICP: VP Product, VP Product Development, VP Innovation, VP Research and Development, Director of R&D.

sections.heading: Gaps and risks
sections.body:
• Application fit: 4 more application area(s) would reach the ceiling.
• Company size: Any published revenue or headcount would unlock up to 15 points.
• Event engagement: Confirming attendance at one more show would add points.
• Flags on the record: size unknown
